lede: The school board's vote Tuesday on a flood-related budget appropriation for FY 2026-27 is the sharpest item of the week — real money being redirected because the canyon flooded, and the district has to adjust. Alongside that, the Ethics Commission is drafting a formal Code of Conduct recommendation for Town Council, the Telluride Medical Center board is weighing a Two Site Model that would shape what gets built and where, and TMVOA is moving to formalize its workforce housing response.

notable.stake: Board votes to adjust district budget due to flood damage costs.
Commission drafts Code of Conduct recommendation that goes to Town Council.
CCAP funding discussion carries direct budget implications for the county.
Board may act on Two Site Model shaping scope and location of new hospital.
Board votes on workforce housing committee formation and updated policies.
